subtype_label: Focus internal / focus inference (no given focus)
query: Help me understand what's in these food-product reviews and what's worth attention or actionable.

judge.implied_focus: Product-review-derived assessment of food product quality and satisfaction (what drives whether a product is worth attention/action)

per_column.name: product_category
per_column.rationale: Segmenting variable that lets quality/satisfaction facets be analysed by product type; a coherent grouping dimension.

per_column.name: taste_quality_verdict
per_column.rationale: Core quality facet for food products, directly central to whether a product is good.

per_column.name: texture_quality
per_column.rationale: Distinct sensory quality facet complementing taste.

per_column.name: health_dietary_claim
per_column.rationale: Attribute facet relevant to product appeal and actionable positioning.

per_column.name: product_safety_concern
per_column.rationale: High-priority actionable flag surfacing reviews worth attention.

per_column.name: use_case_context
per_column.rationale: Context facet enriching how/why the product is used, supports segmentation.

per_column.name: repeat_purchase_intent
per_column.rationale: Direct satisfaction/outcome signal, strongly actionable proxy for product value.

per_column.name: product_consistency_change
per_column.rationale: Actionable flag for quality drift over time, worth attention.

per_column.name: availability_sourcing_note
per_column.rationale: Somewhat peripheral but ties to actionable supply/availability issues.

per_column.name: product_effectiveness_outcome
per_column.rationale: Outcome facet capturing whether the product delivered, central to worthiness.

judge.rationale: The columns collectively centre on a single, data-inferable focus: extracting from review text a structured assessment of food-product quality and customer satisfaction, with an emphasis on 'what's worth attention/actionable'. Sensory quality (taste, texture), attributes (health/dietary claims), context (category, use case), and outcome/signal facets (effectiveness, repeat-purchase intent, safety concerns, consistency changes, availability notes) form a differentiated, well-granulated structure rather than a restatement or noise. Explicit boolean flags (safety concern, consistency change) directly realise the 'worth attention' actionability. availability_sourcing_note is slightly peripheral to a pure quality focus, marginally diluting coherence, but the set is otherwise tightly organised and clearly investigable by an analyst.
